messages:
Jules (AE): FYI Nimbus Logistics asking for POC with dedicated pool + 25% commit discount for a 3-month reserved commit. Opportunity OP-30421. POC timeline = two weeks. Need CPQ field list and approval lane. @Keiko?

Rina (SE): Technical notes: private VPC deploy in us-east-1, 2x A100-equivalent nodes, encryption at rest, want 2k in trial credits. Expected committed spend (pre-discount) ~ $28,500 for 3 months. Will need SCIM for SSO.

Keiko (Deal Desk): Use CPQ doc `DEDICATED_POC_AMEND_v1`. Required Opportunity/Quote fields:

```
Deal_Category__c = POC_DEDICATED
Commit_Length__c = 3M
Commit_Amount__c = 28500
Requested_Discount__c = 25%
Promo_Credits__c = 2000
Security_Annex__c = uploaded
Billing_Model__c = Prepay
Escalate_To_Exec__c = FALSE
```

If discount at or above 25% route automatic approval: Deal Desk -> RevOps -> Legal. SLA: Deal Desk 8h, RevOps 18h, Legal 36h. If customer needs faster response, add tag `urgent-4h` and ping Omar.

Omar (RevOps): Routing automation: create approval when `Requested_Discount__c >= 20%` OR `Deal_Category__c = POC_DEDICATED`. Approval path computed in Salesforce flow `flow.POC_Approval_v3`. I'll attach a CPQ approval matrix to OP-30421.

LegalBot: Auto rule: any private deploy + discount >= 20% requires Legal review and security docs. Please attach SIG questionnaire and data processing addendum. Mark opp `needs-legal`.

Tess (CS): We'll run the POC day-to-day. Need an SOW addendum covering dedicated infra and KPIs. Jules, paste POC success criteria here and confirm whether trial credits apply to commit or are separate.

Jules (AE): POC success criteria:
- avg latency < 250ms under 30s windows
- 40 rps sustained for 20 minutes
- model state persistence across restarts
- logs forwarded to their SIEM via syslog
I confirmed trial credits are non-billable and excluded from committed spend. Uploaded LOI to the opportunity.

Rina (SE): Note: KMS must be enabled and HSM planned. Set `KMS_Required__c = TRUE` and `HSM_Status__c = PLANNED` on the quote. Also include key rotation note in security annex.

Keiko (Deal Desk): Opening deal desk ticket now. Two quick checks: 1) Finance approval for prepay 3-month commit, 2) ensure trial credits flagged non-committal. If both OK, we'll approve at Deal Desk level. If they push to 30% discount, escalate to RevOps leadership.

Omar (RevOps): Added CPQ amendment AMND-POC-30421-v2 and automation to create task for @Keiko when `Escalate_To_Exec__c = TRUE`.

Tess (CS): Confirmed credits are non-committal. Attaching SOW addendum and KPI sheet.

Keiko (Deal Desk): Received docs. ETA to initial decision ~ 6-9 hours (we're in the fast lane). Will update thread with ApprovalRef once complete.

LegalBot: Run `legal-scan --opp OP-30421` after uploads. Reminder: include DPAs for EU data subprocessors if any cross-border elements later.
